description: Posts a ready video to your connected accounts now, at a time (mode schedule), or in the profile queue. Only after preview_post passed and the user agreed: confirm must be true. For TikTok, pass the tiktok.privacy_level the user chose. idempotency_key: a new unique string per intended post. Repeat the same call with the same key only when it did not answer (timeout, network): you get the same post back, never a second one. A post that came back failed needs a new key; the same key with different arguments is refused (idempotency_mismatch). Counts one post per account against your plan.

account_ids.description: Accounts of that profile to post to (list_profiles, postable: true)

ai_generated.description: Label the post as AI-generated where the network supports it (default: true for AI swaps, false for your own videos)

caption.description: Post text on every network (on YouTube: the description)

confirm.description: Must be true: the user agreed to publish

cover_offset_ms.description: Cover frame: milliseconds into the video. TikTok and Instagram use that frame, YouTube and Facebook get it as the cover image. Omit to let each network pick (often the first frame).

first_comment.description: Posted as the first comment where the network supports it

idempotency_key.description: A new unique string per intended post

mode.description: 'now', 'schedule' (needs scheduled_at) or 'queue' (the profile's next free slot)

overrides.description: Per network (tiktok, instagram, youtube, facebook, linkedin, threads, reddit, bluesky): a different caption and, on titled networks (YouTube), a different title. Networks left out use caption / title.

reddit.description: Required when a Reddit account is targeted

tiktok.description: TikTok settings, used when a TikTok account is targeted. Ask the user who can view it (privacy_level) before preview_post.

comment_in_caption.description: TikTok has no first comments: add first_comment to the end of the TikTok caption instead (default false)

disable_comment.description: Turn comments off on the TikTok post (default: on, unless the account turned them off)

disable_duet.description: Turn Duet off (default: on, unless the account turned it off)

disable_stitch.description: Turn Stitch off (default: on, unless the account turned it off)

post_mode.description: DIRECT_POST (default): published to the TikTok profile, needs privacy_level. MEDIA_UPLOAD: sent to the user's TikTok inbox as a draft they finish in the TikTok app (no privacy_level).

privacy_level.description: Who can view the TikTok post: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE (everyone), MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS (friends (mutual followers)), FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR (followers), SELF_ONLY (only me). Required to post directly to TikTok, and only the values list_profiles shows in the account's tiktok.privacy_level_options are allowed (preview_post lists them when one is missing or not allowed). There is no default: ask the user who can view it, never choose for them.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Madrid (default: the server default)

title.description: Title for titled networks (YouTube); required when one is targeted

name: publish_post
title: Publish or schedule a post
